newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fall sharply on economic worries.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fall sharply on economic worries.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fell sharply on Thursday on deepening gloom about the Japanese economy, with the market's key index closing at its lowest level this year.
The key Nikkei average of 225 leading shares ended down 2.60 percent, or 522.36 points lower, at 19,570.67 points, after selling in cash stocks and futures escalated shortly before the close.

The Nikkei had earlier fallen below key psychological levels at 20,000 points and at around 19,920 points -- where it had previously found a floor -- as worries about Japan's sluggish economic recovery pervaded the market.
